project_name: 24h Carbon-Silicon Night Relay Complete DAG Suite

tasks.title: Harden Python CSR SpMM Boundary, Negative Index & Compensated Sum
tasks.spec: Validate CSR row_ptr invariants and column bounds (no Python negative wrap-around), skip empty rows, reject non-finite inputs, and use math.fsum.

tasks.title: Align Vector Scale Operator to IEEE-754 Float32 Precision
tasks.spec: Compute exact IEEE-754 float32 (a + b) * scale without decimal round(..., 6) truncation; validate shape equality and finiteness.

tasks.title: Implement Isolated GQA KV-Cache Repeat-Interleave Broadcast
tasks.spec: Expand [batch, num_kv_heads, seq_len, head_dim] to num_query_heads with independent head buffers and divisibility checks.

tasks.title: Multi-File Token Batch Scheduler & Hidden Holdout Verification
tasks.spec: Fix weighted_score in precision.py (length/finiteness checks + math.fsum) and dispatch_batch in scheduler.py (descending priority, id tie-break, token capacity, non-mutating output).

tasks.title: Native C++17 Tiled CSR SpMV Compile Gate & FP64 Accumulator
tasks.spec: Fix C++17 4-way unrolled tiled_csr_spmv_f32 in kernel.hpp: validate CSR bounds and std::isfinite, add scalar tail loop for (nnz % 4 != 0), and accumulate in double before casting to float.
